title: Lodging and local audiences' feeling for jazz in Asia
summary: Addie describes hotels and stays with American families; Jack says Asian audiences are fascinated and already hear jazz on American radio.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Now where did you all stay in these various places? Did you stay with the kids?
Well in most cities there's either one good hotel by Western Standard or there are none. Then we stayed with American families and you had a USIM public affairs office.
Do these people seem to understand jazz in Asia? Do they have a real feeling, Floyd?
Most of them are already familiar with them.
Yeah they hear it on the West of America. They do a very good job.
The radio is on and off.
